mknkYahooCompress 3.0.4 Native - REVIEW FIX VALIDATION REPORT
==========================================================

Date: 2026-11-06 (Asia/Tokyo)
Provider: ネコシステム社 / Neko System
Target: Windows 10/11, x64/x86/ARM64
Runtime: Win32 + Windows Imaging Component

Changes
-------
- Refresh the current source size for retries after an input is replaced.
- Reject additions during processing and explicitly ask the user to retry
  after completion or cancellation.
- Count accepted additions rather than all entries in the existing list.
- Publish worker results and copy display snapshots under a mutex.
- Release worker WIC objects before uninitializing its COM apartment.
- Carry progress totals without the previous 16-bit truncation.
- Preserve completed entries and compress only eligible entries.
- Identify the new review-fix Windows, all-architectures and source ZIPs.

Validation performed
--------------------
PASS  Static source/feature assertions: 33 checks.
PASS  JavaScript reference algorithm checks: 16 checks.
PASS  Native compression-queue tests: 9 scenarios on Windows x64.
PASS  Native compression-queue tests: 9 scenarios on Windows x86.
PASS  Asynchronous WindowProc tests: 6 scenarios on Windows x64.
PASS  Asynchronous WindowProc tests: 6 scenarios on Windows x86.
PASS  Queue and WindowProc test executables compiled for ARM64.
PASS  Existing native window-placement tests: 9 scenarios on Windows x64.
PASS  LLVM-MinGW 20250613 UCRT / Clang 20.1.7 application builds:
      x64, x86 and ARM64.
PASS  All application EXEs: architecture, GUI subsystem, ASLR, DEP and CFG;
      Japanese CompanyName resource; no dynamic C++ runtime DLL imports.
PASS  Independent implementation review: no actionable introduced findings.
PASS  Regression assertion review, including bounded cancellation scheduling.
PASS  Five release ZIPs: all archived files match their verified sources;
      SHA-256 checksum manifest generated and checked.

Regression coverage
-------------------
The queue tests use real BMP/JPEG files and WIC. Worker initializes and
uninitializes its own COM apartment; the test does not keep an outer COM
apartment alive. Cases include repaired inputs that grow or shrink,
deleted inputs, preserved completed results and explicit re-addition.

The UI tests use the real WindowProc, controls, asynchronous worker and
drop messages. Test-only API-boundary redirection isolates the settings
folder, and a notification gate synchronizes the cancellation scenario.
Fixtures use temporary files. The tests verify busy
drop rejection, accepted-addition counts, an all-completed idle start,
completed-result retention, same-path re-addition, directly adding a prior
output JPEG, and a drop accepting zero images.

Cancellation is triggered by an actual candidate notification for the
second image, after the first completes while the third remains pending.
The test checks that resuming processes only the two remaining images.
The real progress handler is also checked at 32,768/65,536 (50%) and
65,536/65,536 (100%); this is a message-boundary test, not a compression
run containing 65,536 actual input images.

Platform limits
---------------
- ARM64 application and test executables were built but not run on ARM64
  hardware.
- MSVC/CMake and remote GitHub Actions execution were not performed.
- Automated hidden-window/message tests do not cover actual mouse
  operation or manual file-selection dialogs.
- Physical multi-monitor, mixed-DPI and Windows logoff interactions were
  not tested as part of this review fix.

Fixed image rules remain JPG-only, <= original size and <= 5,000,000 bytes,
with maximum long edge 1200px. The application version remains 3.0.4.
